title: Stunts Online
author: Byproduct
selftext:
[https://Stunts-Online.com](https://stunts-online.com/) is open!

It's a reverse-engineer/remake that drives identically to Stunts (aka 4D Spots Driving), abandonware from 1990, but we've added a whole bunch of modern features, like smooth framerate, online leaderboards, ghost cars, new track editor with new track features, and much more. If you recognize the original game, this might be fun to check out.

It's completely free to play, and runs directly in browser without installing anything. There's nothing commercial in it. The flair says "commercial self-promotion", just because that's the closest thing there was to self-promotion.

The original game is obviously not AI-made, and neither are most of our new features, but the reverse-engineering and conversion from C to typescript was done by AI.
